offering_description.value: Compass Minerals mines and processes salt for road agencies, businesses and households. It produces sulfate of potash fertilizer from Great Salt Lake brine for agricultural customers. It also provides records storage and retrieval using space in a UK salt mine.

primary_products.value: Highway deicing salt; packaged ice melt; water-softening salt; food and industrial salt; sulfate of potash fertilizer

customer_segment.value: B2G: State, provincial and local road agencies and public-sector records customers; B2B: Salt distributors, retailers, food and industrial processors, agricultural distributors, growers and organizations with physical archives; B2C: Households buying ice melt or water-softening salt through retailers

end_markets.value: Road maintenance and winter safety; water treatment; food and industrial processing; agriculture; records management

revenue_model.value: product sales: Bulk and packaged salt and specialty potash fertilizer; service fees: Physical document storage and retrieval

value_chain_position.value: raw materials: Mines rock salt for road agencies and industrial buyers; OEM / manufacturer: Processes salt and lake brine into packaged salt and specialty fertilizer for retailers, distributors and growers; asset operator: Runs salt mines, evaporation ponds and processing plants that supply road agencies, distributors and industrial buyers; service provider: Stores and retrieves physical records for businesses and public agencies
value_chain_position.category: raw materials; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: global: Primarily the United States, Canada and the United Kingdom

specialization.value: related lines: Salt and specialty potash production, with a smaller records storage operation that uses salt mine space

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Bulk supply contracts with road agencies and direct sales to industrial buyers; distributors / dealers: Salt wholesalers, water treatment dealers and agricultural input distributors; third-party retail: Retail stores selling packaged ice melt and water-softening salt
distribution_channels.category: direct sales; distributors / dealers; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Mining and brine extraction are subject to environmental permits and mine safety rules, including U.S. MSHA oversight.

notes: The current ownership of the UK records storage operation is uncertain.
